episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a Friday edition of Barely Informed News covering the arrest of Tyler James Robinson for the Charlie Kirk shooting, with Jevrything co-anchoring and revealing a snake-throat vocal implant. Guy Redacted fails to produce a viable Charlie Brown conspiracy, declaring all children's media alien indoctrination. The Encircled segment pits a carrot-bodied Daniel LaRusso against snake karate practitioners in a lethal fire-trap debate. A protest-driven news rundown covers WWE's Saudi WrestleMania, Nepal's ChatGPT-selected leader, and competitive eating. Hate Sock abuses Scrum and Kendall before DJ C4 produces an explicit 'I Have Sex' track with Trent and Chris, ending with a raid on Static Slater.
